jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

This position designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life. Responsible for the full product lifecycle management, with a technical focus, including strategy, design, development, management, and end of life of new, existing or acquisition products. Leverage market insights to understand market/customer needs as well as emerging technology developments and trends to identify new opportunities or make adjustments to current product offerings. Balances deep subject matter expertise in the product, business use cases and solid technical aptitude. Accountable for delivering product performance against expectations and updates changes to a product portfolio to improve competitive position, and optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. Accountable to and/or own the P\&L. Responsible for cross\-functional stakeholder management to include but not limited to design, engineering, scrum teams, business leaders, etc., functioning as technical expert with a fluency in development concepts and modern development practices. Positions in this function may require a background or degree in computer science or engineering.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provides explanations and interpretations within area of expertise
* Functions as dedicated Technical Product Owner (TPO) on 2 right sized, preferably co\-located agile development teams. Responsible for backlog prioritization and refinement according to direction from Strategic Product Management (SPM) and other TPM leads
* Be able to articulate detailed product overview, benefits, and associated personas
* Follows existing and defined requirements gathering and PI execution process while considering and suggesting improvement opportunities
* Participates and presents PI plans for teams in PI planning events
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 4\+ years of experience in product development or product management
* 2\+ years of product owner experience working on at least one agile scrum team
* Proficient understanding of the basics of the role of technical product management, agile practices/methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle ((SDLC)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition
* Proficient TPM assigned complex feature work on a single, primary product
* Proficient understanding of the role of technical product management, agile practices and the SDLC. Fluent with existing product tools for tracking and user story creation (Aha, Rally)
* Proficient level of experience in discovery, requirement definition and user story definition. With minimal guidance and oversight, can write quality stories, manage team and product dependencies and accept quality enhancements
* Proven excellent communication, organization and interpersonal skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Business, or a related field
* Certified scrum product owner
* Experience in product tools including Aha and Rally
* Experience with healthcare IT and/or knowledge of hospital revenue cycle

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Product Manager, Google Pay
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Pay is one the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for all Indians. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services to every Indian. Specifically, Google Pay aims to empower every Indian with the confidence to participate in the digital economy by making it the simplest, safest, and most trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce friction in transactions and increase the value of money experiences.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams.
* Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy.
* Develop and secure buy\-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
* Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user\-based, strategic opportunity, business generation).
* Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay

**How is this team contributing to vision of Providence?**


We specialize in developing technological solutions that streamline and enhance every aspect of healthcare delivery. Our approach revolves around prioritizing the patient and provider, ensuring they are at the heart of all our innovations. By leveraging the most promising ideas and insights gleaned from healthcare experts, we are dedicated to crafting seamless experiences that benefit care facilities and their patients alike. This commitment drives us forward in our mission of "Health for a better world."

* Design, develop, and maintain advanced software solutions using .NET, Python, integrating and optimizing Language Model frameworks for various applications.
* Apply Object\-Oriented Principles, algorithms, and debugging techniques to ensure robust and scalable code solutions.
* Utilize version control systems (e.g., Git) proficiently to manage source code and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
* Implement Coding Design Patterns and adhere to SOLID Principles to promote code maintainability, scalability, and reusability.
* Develop and execute comprehensive unit tests using frameworks like pytest /unittest/NUnit to validate functionality and performance.
* Lead and contribute to Agile practices, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality software.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders including product managers, data scientists, and UX/UI designers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership in software design and architecture, ensuring adherence to best practices and scalability
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Language Model frameworks and contribute to their integration and enhancement within our software ecosystem.

**What would your week look like?**


* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, and developers to deliver high\-quality software solutions.

**Who we are looking for?**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5 \- 8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong emphasis on **C\#.NET, Python** and proficiency in **LLM frameworks** such as LangChain.
* Solid understanding of **RAG, fine tuning techniques, building AI agents**
* Working knowledge of foundation models like Claude/OpenAI, **Vector store**
* Excellent communication skills and ability to manage stakeholders, ensuring alignment of technical solutions with business goals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail in software design and architecture.
* Previous experience mentoring junior engineers and guiding technical decisions.
* Very good at Vibe coding and rapid development
  
Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part\-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ\+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. Overview:
**About JAGGAER**  

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Role Summary:**  

The Global Nurture Campaigns Manager will own the execution, optimization, and governance of JAGGAER's marketing automation programs across Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). This role will be responsible for building scalable campaign infrastructure, managing automated journeys, maintaining data quality, and ensuring marketing programs move prospects and customers through the funnel effectively.  

This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Content, Digital, and regional marketing teams to translate campaign strategy into technically sound, measurable programs. The position will manage campaign setup, segmentation, lead routing, scoring, nurture programs, email execution, testing, reporting, and ongoing platform optimization.  

The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on Pardot and Salesforce expertise with campaign operations discipline, lifecycle marketing knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to improve processes at scale.

* Continuously test cadence, subject lines, messaging, calls to action, segmentation, and journey logic to improve engagement and downstream pipeline impact.

* Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing Operations to improve lead status governance, campaign member statuses, attribution inputs, and CRM data consistency.

* Maintain suppression logic, consent requirements, subscription preferences, and data hygiene processes to improve deliverability and campaign quality.

jobs.title: Digital Commerce - Commercial Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The main purpose of the role is to enable US Digital Commerce Sales team of Walmart with timely insights, advanced analytics, data intelligence \& business recommendations. The role will work on a daily basis with mid level to Senior level Sales leaders in the org, be their go\-to person for all analytics and deep dive needs. The role will be responsible for digitizing Sales processes, building/ leveraging quick automation solutions/ tools and contribute effectively to the long term Tech needs of the Walmart team by collaborating on regular basis with the DTX team or other Product teams. The role will be responsible for driving efficiencies within current processes, identifying further opportunities, executing change and improving Customer satisfaction with the service we provide.

  



The role will need to deliver high quality channel analytics to deep dive on relevant business problems, solve through actionable insights and recommendations to business team, thereby influencing business decision making. Incumbent will be responsible to build compelling stories from the data \& showcase impactful presentations to Senior Leaders. The role will be accountable for accurate measurement \& reporting of important business KPIs. The role will function as Digital Commerce SME (subject matter expert) building sharp domain knowledge \& market intelligence in the long run. This will be an IC role (Individual Contributor).


Responsibilities:
* Be the go\-to person for US Walmart team to enable timely analysis, insight generation, actionable recommenations, opportunity analysis
* Leverage existing tools, create new scorecards or enhance existing ones, support dashboarding requirements as needed. Elevate scorecards with advanced analytics, including projections, automations \& potentially language learning models
* Advanced data fluency across disparate data sources, including Promotions data \& forecasting data
* Prepare monthly drivers \& drags, highlights, weekly emails, customer call\-outs \& perform advanced analytics
* Run weekly execution and summary of insights/drivers/trends – weekly Share report build outs, elevate reporting with AI custom\-built for the Walmart Sales team, saving the team time. Provide key highlights in the form of sales drivers and drags, Share change analysis, Share of Voice analysis \& other key business insights
* Collaborate with DTX / Tech team to build solutions/ tools \& further digitize Sales funnel through Machine Learning
* Lead with Sales team to influence functions like Finance, RGM, Walmart PCT, GTM \& Supply Chain teams
* WBR, MBR, QBR, AOP, JBP, Divisional decks, Customer meetings: remain actively engaged, deep dive \& prepare content with guidance from Sales Leads including trends, business performance, view on multiple metrics, insights \& Next Best Action plans
* Constantly adapting to channel shifts at WM and translating that to the workstreams (e.g. SFS/DFS, Node inStock)
* Build presentation for POR decks, dComm business updates (2\-3 pagers) \- internal \& customer\-facing

jobs.title: Customer Success Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is seeking a highly analytical and customer\-focused **Customer Success Data Analyst** to join the global Customer Success organization in India. This mid\-senior individual contributor role will support the Reuters Connect and Reuters News Agency portfolio, helping customers realize measurable value from Reuters editorial content, data feeds, and media services.


The Customer Success Data Analyst will transform customer usage data, engagement signals, commercial information, and product health metrics into clear and actionable insights. This role goes beyond producing reports: it is responsible for identifying the story behind the data, diagnosing adoption and engagement challenges, surfacing commercial risks and opportunities, and enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to make informed retention and growth decisions.


Reporting to the Director of Customer \& Sales Enablement, the successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Editorial, Product, Data, Sales Enablement, and Commercial Policy \& Operations teams. The role requires strong critical thinking, advanced business intelligence and reporting skills, data\-quality rigor, and the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to both internal stakeholders and clients.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own and enhance customer health scoring methodologies across the Reuters portfolio, including defining metrics, developing models, and identifying early churn\-risk indicators.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of individual accounts and customer segments to diagnose declining engagement, adoption gaps, underutilization, and commercial risk.
* Segment customers based on health, usage trends, engagement trajectory, commercial value, and expansion potential to support Customer Success and Sales prioritization.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, engagement, and commercial data to identify retention and growth opportunities.
* Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, scorecards, and insight\-led narratives for Customer Success Managers, Sales teams, senior stakeholders, and clients.
* Translate customer data into clear and actionable recommendations that support renewals, retention, adoption, expansion, and customer value realization.
* Support Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, renewal discussions, and customer meetings with tailored data\-driven insights.
* Help customers understand their content consumption and product\-usage patterns and demonstrate the business value of Reuters products and services.
* Identify trends, anomalies, data patterns, and commercial signals while applying critical thinking to validate findings before presenting conclusions.
* Support customer feedback, Voice of Customer, and customer\-sentiment analysis initiatives.
* Partner with the Data team to build, improve, and maintain scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
* Use Salesforce and related tools for reporting, dashboard development, data management, customer activity tracking, and commercial analysis.
* Ensure data quality across Customer Success reporting by identifying, investigating, and resolving inconsistencies in CRM, usage, engagement, and customer\-record data.
* Collaborate with internal data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Incorporate AI\-enabled tools and automation into reporting and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and analytical depth.
* Work independently in a global, matrixed environment while managing multiple priorities, stakeholder requests, and reporting deadlines.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, customer success analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
* Experience working in a SaaS, B2B, technology, media, data services, subscription, or customer\-focused commercial environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex reporting, analysis, modeling, and presentation of findings.
* Strong hands\-on experience using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data\-visualization platforms.
* Hands\-on Salesforce experience, including report creation, dashboard development, data management, activity tracking, and CRM data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, customer scorecards, analytical models, and recurring performance reporting.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking ability, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, validate data, and identify actionable findings.
* Experience analyzing customer engagement, product usage, customer adoption, retention, and commercial performance data.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes, and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Proven ability to present complex data findings clearly and confidently to non\-technical audiences, including external clients.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder\-management, planning, prioritization, organization, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently in a globally distributed and matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience developing or improving customer health\-scoring frameworks, engagement models, churn\-risk models, or customer segmentation methodologies.
* Experience with Net Promoter Score, Voice of Customer, customer\-feedback programs…

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Direct Payments
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations**
 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.
   

  

 We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions.
* Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi\-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
* Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
* Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
* Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of the scheme integration.


**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**
* Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
+ 8\+ years in the workforce with ideally 5\+ years in product management or product\-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3\+ years in a senior product manager role

* A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
* Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
* Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
* A strong track record shipping customer\-facing products end\-to\-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade\-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with payment scheme integrations
* Experience in fintech or a high\-growth tech company.
* The ability to write SQL
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.

Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding \& KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high\-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low\-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.
   

  

 This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk \& Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
* Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC\-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
* Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time\-to\-verify, manual review rates, cost\-to\-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
* Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in\-product control environment accounts for country\-specific financial crime risks.
* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.


**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for**
* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust \& safety, or another regulated domain.
+ 8\+ years in the workforce with ideally 5\+ years in product management or product\-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3\+ years in a senior product manager role

* A strong track record shipping customer\-facing products end\-to\-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade\-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,


**Nice to have**
* Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding,
* Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.

 We’re looking for a strategic and execution\-focused Senior Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of intelligent, scalable product experiences. In this role, you will own the product vision, shape the platform strategy, and drive meaningful business impact. From uncovering customer insights to launching and scaling adoption, you will lead the roadmap end\-to\-end — defining priorities, making critical trade\-offs, and delivering outcomes that matter. Working at the intersection of Engineering, Design, AI, and Go\-to\-Market teams, you will build intelligent, scalable product experiences that redefine how enterprises engage, operate, and grow.

Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database\-centric implementations into testable, cloud\-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in\-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. **What This Is Not**


This is not an architecture\-only or people\-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.

Decisions must balance long\-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

* Contribute to special projects and continuous improvement initiatives, demonstrating commercial awareness, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of the WSO Core Operations team.

**Key qualifications**


* Finance Knowledge, Operations Experience, or a related field; or equivalent experience in operations, shared services, or outsourcing environments.

Apply today!

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:

* 7\+ Years experience building modern data solutions using Snowflake, Structured Query Language, Python, Apache Spark, and cloud technologies.
* Strong expertise in extract, transform, load and extract, load, transform processes, data modelling, orchestration, and performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services services including Glue, Simple Storage Service, Lambda, Step Functions, and workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience implementing data governance, metadata management, lineage, compliance, and security controls using governance platforms.
* Familiarity with artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, including Generative Artificial Intelligence, machine learning operations, and automation concepts.
* Experience applying continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, version control, and cloud\-native engineering practices.

### **Desirable Requirements**

* Experience supporting Generative Artificial Intelligence, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, or artificial intelligence\-driven automation solutions.
* Experience mentoring engineers and driving adoption of engineering best practices across teams.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Technical Product Owner** 
 to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end\-to\-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* FinOps. Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* Discovery for what comes next. New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* Possibly more. Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* Outcomes, not output. You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.


 What you will do
   

  

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area


**What You Bring**
* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
* You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..


**Who We Are**
 At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
   

  

 Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
   

  

 With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
   

  

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**
 WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

**Description**
 Have you ever thought about what it takes to protect hundreds of millions of Amazon customers from having their accounts compromised? At Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT), we are on the front lines of detecting and preventing Account Takeover (ATO), one of the most sophisticated and evolving threats in e\-commerce fraud.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) team, specifically focused on the ATO charter. In this role, you will own the analytical backbone of our ATO detection and prevention programs — from building enforcement metrics to evaluating the effectiveness of rule\-based and ML\-driven interventions across millions of sign\-in events globally.
   

  

 In this role, you will be the analytical authority for performance measurement and program insights. You will work closely with Science, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to translate complex fraud signals into actionable strategies.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You will own end\-to\-end metrics, building and maintaining dashboards that track critical performance indicators across global marketplaces.
* You will analyze sign\-in event data at scale to identify emerging threat patterns and gaps in current enforcement coverage.
* You will evaluate the performance of enforcement outputs to drive optimization recommendations and build and maintain Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) reports for senior leadership, synthesizing trends and experiment outcomes.
* You will design and analyze A/B experiments (treatment vs. control) to measure the impact of new enforcement strategies and partner with the Science team to evaluate model performance.
* You will develop scalable SQL\-based data pipelines and dashboards to support ongoing monitoring of enforcement health and rule effectiveness, and translate analytical findings into clear business recommendations for stakeholders, including PMs, SDEs, and senior leadership.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 3\+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Experience with Excel


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Project Financial Management
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Financial Management**
* Partner with project teams to develop, monitor, and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and financial plans.
* Analyze project actuals, commitments, accruals, and forecast variances.
* Identify financial risks, gaps, and corrective actions to ensure projects remain within approved budgets.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and forecasting activities.
* Track project spend against approved funding and provide recommendations to improve financial performance.


**Financial Analysis \& Reporting**
* Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and analysis for project and portfolio stakeholders.
* Perform detailed variance analysis and explain key financial trends.
* Maintain financial data integrity within ERP and Project Portfolio Management systems.
* Support leadership reporting through development of accurate and timely financial insights.
* Assist in financial modeling and scenario analysis activities.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Ensure adherence to Project Financial Management standards, processes, and controls.
* Support project audits, financial reviews, and governance activities.
* Maintain project financial documentation and supporting records.
* Assist with project capitalization, procurement, and financial compliance activities.
* Drive issue identification and resolution for project financial concerns.


**Procurement \& Vendor Financial Support**
* Coordinate creation and maintenance of Purchase Orders.
* Monitor vendor spending and financial commitments.
* Support invoice reconciliation and financial tracking activities.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure timely processing of project expenditures.


**AI, Analytics \& Automation**
* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and financial management activities.
* Leverage Generative AI tools to improve reporting, variance analysis, forecasting, and documentation quality.
* Develop AI\-assisted dashboards and insights to improve project financial transparency.
* Utilize automation platforms such as Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or similar tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of AI and automation initiatives across project financial processes.


**Process Improvement**
* Document project financial processes and recommend enhancements.
* Implement best practices that improve financial governance, reporting consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on financial operations and project delivery excellence.
* Support optimization of ServiceNow PPM and financial management workflows.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner effectively with project managers, PMOs, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate financial information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Provide guidance and support on project financial processes and reporting requirements.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and project governance activities.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4–7 years of experience in Project Financial Management, Financial Analysis, PMO Operations, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting medium to large\-scale technology or business transformation projects.
* Experience working within matrixed global organizations.


**Financial \& Business Skills**
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, accruals, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
* Knowledge of project lifecycle financial management.
* Understanding of procurement processes and Purchase Order management.
* Ability to analyze large datasets and identify meaningful insights.


**Technical Skills**
* Intermediate to advanced experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday Financials, or similar).
* Experience using Project Portfolio Management tools (ServiceNow PPM, Planview, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and financial modeling.
* Strong PowerPoint and data visualization capabilities.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics platforms.


**AI \& Automation Skills**
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar platforms.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate plays a crucial role in the Loans group, responsible for delivering on key operational tasks and driving excellence. This position offers valuable exposure to a wide range of banking processes, contributing to the seamless operation and success of our financial services. Join our dynamic team to make a significant impact and support our clients in a collaborative environment.


**Job Summary**


As a Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate within the Loans group, you will be responsible for closely monitoring and guiding your team to ensure all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are consistently met. You will oversee a variety of processes, including Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, Pre\-payments, Funding, Rate\-Fixings, Fees, and external payments. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your skills in managing Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation and make a significant impact on our operations.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Monitor the team daily to ensure all SLAs are met and escalate exceptions immediately for resolution.
* Supervise processes such as Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, and Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation.
* Ensure adherence to quality and quantity SLAs and maintain a robust workflow allocation model.
* Serve as the SME, handling complex process\-related queries and routing them to onshore teams if needed.
* Implement a robust Knowledge Management model, including SOP maintenance and training.
* Drive 100% compliance with process\-related policies, guidelines, and controls.
* Motivate and support team members to meet goals, identifying high\-potential employees and planning for their development.
* Identify alternatives and options for issues, seeking alternative scenarios.
* Work successfully with others, valuing diverse skills and building interdependence.
* Identify training needs to improve performance and ensure compliance with training timelines.
* Ensure high team depth with trained backups for critical work queues.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Hold a Bachelor's degree with minimum 8 years of relevant experience in credit support or loan servicing, ideally in syndicated loans or financial industry roles.
* Gain knowledge of loan systems such as Loan IQ.
* Possess expertise in nostro/cash matching, General Ledger reconciliation, and SWIFT/remittance systems.
* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving and investigative skills to analyze and resolve process\-related issues.
* Maintain a robust risk and control mindset.
* Understand investment banking products, including loans.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.



Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.



It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.



Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.



In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.

 **About the Role**



Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100\+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off\-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




  




* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade\-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade\-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two\-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5\+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top\-tier institution, or hands\-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6\.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
 



  





 At Greenlight, we're here to make the day\-to\-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 



  





 Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. Access, identity management, authentication and notifications are the foundation every Greenlight experience runs on, they decide who gets into the door, and whether the right person hears from us at the right moment. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end\-to\-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi\-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day.
 



  





 This is a high\-leverage, high\-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. Your customers are both the families using our products who should never have to think about any of this and the product teams building on top of you, who ship faster when your systems are reliable. You'll work cross\-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US \& India) , and you'll have direct line\-of\-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products.
 



  





 This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.
 



  





**Your day\-to\-day:** 



* Working closely with Engineering and design to ensure building great product.
* Work closely with key stakeholders for new requirements and ensure to keep teams updated on ongoing items
* Owning the key metrics for your product and ensuring the reliability of the product.
* Embedded in a dedicated cross\-functional pod with Engineering and Design, with close partnerships across Security, Risk and Compliance, Legal, Data, Customer Support, and the consumer product teams who depend on your platform.



  





**What you’ll bring to the team:** 



* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years building platform products
* Comfortable to build long term strategy for your product vertical and drive the key projects independently end to end.
* Strong cross\-functional instincts \- you’ve navigated complex stakeholder environments including Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Payments, and know how to move fast within constraints.
* Executive presence: you communicate up and across clearly, adapt your message to your audience, and don’t wait to be asked for updates.
* Ownership mentality \- you proactively identify gaps, propose solutions, and follow through. You don’t need a playbook to get started.
* Urgency and scrappiness: experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments where speed matters and you figure things out yourself.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Fintech experience or a familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), authentication standards



  





**Who we are:** 




 It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.
 



  





 Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

You will identify, structure, and close transformative partnerships that unlock new revenue streams, shape product monetization strategy, and influence how Meta's platforms generate sustainable value at scale. This is a role for a experienced business development leader who can operate with full autonomy across complex, ambiguous deal environments and drive company\-level outcomes.  

  

  

### **Business Development Manager, Monetization Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead the long\-term monetization partnership strategy across Meta's advertising, commerce, and platform revenue surfaces
* Identify, evaluate, and execute high\-value strategic partnerships that unlock new monetization opportunities or expand existing revenue streams
* Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including revenue\-sharing arrangements, API monetization deals, and platform licensing frameworks
* Collaborate with product, engineering, legal, and finance teams to align partnership structures with Meta's monetization product roadmap
* Develop and own executive\-level business cases and investment theses for new monetization initiatives, presenting to senior leadership
* Establish frameworks for evaluating partnership ROI, deal economics, and long\-term revenue impact across Meta's monetization portfolio
* Serve as the primary external relationship owner for strategic monetization partners, managing C\-suite and senior stakeholder engagement
* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning
* Provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams on monetization deal structures, market dynamics, and competitive landscape
* Drive organizational alignment on monetization partnership priorities, influencing roadmap decisions and resource allocation across business units

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi\-party commercial agreements including revenue\-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large\-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C\-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high\-stakes deal environments with accountability for company\-level outcomes

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up
* Background in commerce, payments, or emerging platform monetization surfaces such as messaging, AI\-driven experiences, or wearables
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in digital advertising ecosystem partnerships, including programmatic, performance marketing, or ad tech monetization models
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex deal structures into clear financial models and executive\-ready strategic narratives
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **Description**
 Trintech is an award\-winning AI\-driven FinTech SaaS company transforming how organisations automate their financial close. We're looking for a Senior Product Owner to join our AI Platform team. This is a strategic platform role focused on the shared capabilities that power every AI agent across our products.
   

  

 As our AI ecosystem grows, this role will ensure the platform remains consistent, scalable and easy for product teams to build on. You'll own the platform capability roadmap and API contract, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering and the Platform Architect to prioritise platform investments, govern shared capabilities and prevent platform fragmentation.
   

  

 While the platform is currently internal, our long\-term vision is to evolve it into a customer\-facing platform where users can configure, orchestrate and interact with multiple AI agents. The decisions you make today will help shape that future.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Own the Platform
   

  

* Own the platform capability roadmap, defining what capabilities the platform exposes and how they evolve.
* Maintain and govern the platform API contract, ensuring it remains the single source of truth for APIs, event schemas and shared capabilities.
* Define platform standards that create a consistent experience across all AI agents.


 Drive Cross\-Team Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners across multiple AI squads to understand platform needs and prioritise shared capabilities.
* Consolidate similar requests into reusable platform solutions rather than one\-off features.
* Challenge requirements that could create inconsistency or unnecessary complexity across the platform.
* Identify emerging platform needs and proactively shape future capabilities.


 Collaborate Across the Business
   

  

* Work closely with the Platform Architect and Engineering Manager to balance product priorities with technical strategy.
* Communicate roadmap priorities, sequencing and platform decisions to stakeholders.
* Ensure platform investments support both immediate delivery needs and the long\-term product vision.


**What You'll Have**
* 8\+ years' experience as a Product Owner or similar product role.
* Experience delivering enterprise SaaS products, platforms or developer\-facing capabilities.
* Proven experience managing product roadmaps and prioritising work across multiple teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, event\-driven systems and platform architecture with engineering teams.


 Bonus points for
   

  

* Experience owning a platform, infrastructure or API product.
* Exposure to AI products, machine learning or agentic platforms.
* Azure or cloud platform experience.
* Financial software, Office of the CFO or Record\-to\-Report domain knowledge.
* Experience with Product\-Led Growth (PLG) or self\-service products.


**Why Join Trintech?**
 This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation of Trintech's AI strategy. You'll influence the platform that every AI team builds upon while helping evolve it from internal infrastructure into a customer\-facing multi\-agent platform. *At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*

**Job Title**
 Product Owner
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Product Owner serves as the primary product authority and trusted advisor for airline clients adopting the mobile application (iOS and Android). This role owns the end\-to\-end mobile product experience for each client — translating their business goals, branding, and operational needs into a tailored, well\-prioritized mobile app backlog. Working closely with airline client stakeholders on one side and internal mobile design, engineering, and delivery teams on the other, the Product Owner ensures each airline's mobile application drives passenger engagement and commercial value. Success is measured by client satisfaction, on\-time delivery of mobile releases, and the business results the app generates for each airline.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Client Engagement \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Act as the main mobile product point of contact for one or more airline clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client product, commercial, digital, and operations stakeholders.
* Run discovery workshops to understand each airline's mobile experience objectives, passenger journey goals, and operational constraints.
* Manage client expectations on mobile app scope, timelines, and trade\-offs; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly.


 Requirements \& Mobile Backlog Ownership
   

  

* Capture, analyze, and translate client requirements into clear mobile app user stories with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the client\-specific mobile product backlog, balancing client requests against platform capabilities and the broader mobile roadmap.
* Distinguish between standard/configurable mobile features and custom development, advising clients on the most efficient path.
* Make data\-informed trade\-off decisions and negotiate mobile feature priorities with clients when demand exceeds capacity.


 Mobile Solution Delivery \& Configuration
   

  

* Guide clients through configuration of core mobile app capabilities: flight search \& booking, check\-in, boarding passes, seat selection, baggage, flight status, push notifications, and disruption handling.
* Oversee branding, localization, and client\-specific business rules within the mobile application.
* Coordinate integration of the mobile app with the airline's systems (PSS/GDS, loyalty, payment gateways, operational data feeds).
* Support ancillary and loyalty feature enablement on mobile to drive client revenue.


 Cross\-Functional Coordination (Internal)
   

  

* Bridge client needs and internal Agile mobile delivery teams; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and mobile app demos.
* Collaborate with mobile UX/UI, engineering, QA, and delivery/project managers to ensure committed features are delivered to quality.
* Channel recurring or high\-value client requests into the core mobile product roadmap as candidate platform features.


 Mobile Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define mobile success metrics with each client (app adoption, conversion, ancillary attach rate, NPS/CSAT, app store rating).
* Use mobile analytics and client feedback to recommend enhancements and demonstrate value realization.
* Conduct post\-release reviews and mobile roadmap planning sessions with clients.


 Governance, Compliance \& Quality
   

  

* Ensure delivered mobile solutions meet aviation regulations, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy (GDPR/PCI\-DSS), and app store guidelines.

Preferred:
